comparison.use_case: Internal SaaS reporting service, relational data, 6-person team that already runs PostgreSQL

performance.evidence: Team load test: p95 38 ms on the 12 heaviest report queries

scalability.evidence: Projected 400 GB in 3 years fits one primary plus read replicas

developer_experience.evidence: All 6 developers have shipped production SQL on it

ecosystem.evidence: ORM, migration tool and BI connector already in use

learning_curve.evidence: No new training needed; existing runbooks

community_support.evidence: Managed offering on current cloud with support contract

enterprise_readiness.evidence: Backups, PITR and audit logging already configured

performance.evidence: Prototype: report joins via $lookup were 3x slower than SQL

scalability.evidence: Sharding available, but no requirement needs it

ecosystem.evidence: BI connector would be new; ORM change required

learning_curve.evidence: Estimated 3 weeks ramp-up from team survey

community_support.evidence: Vendor support would be a new contract

enterprise_readiness.evidence: Backup and audit setup still to be built
